importDialog.title: Import Product Config
importDialog.description: Paste data from Excel (tab-separated). 7 columns in order: Full name — Short name — Machine (machine number, e.g. 94/27, leave blank = no tool) — Factory (e.g. "ME LINH") — Fabric type (POLY 2 DA, ME 64, LUA 4B, LUA VAN GO…) — Tool result (leave blank = has tool; "no tool" = no tool) — Department (machine type, e.g. "PRINT AND LASER CUT"). The system matches labels by name (case-insensitive).
importDialog.parseError: No rows could be parsed. Check the format (7 columns, separated by Tab).

uploadConfigDialog.title: Upload config file
uploadConfigDialog.description: Pick an Excel file (.xlsx) with the product list (columns Tên SP / short name / Nhà máy / Phòng — same layout as the SKU THÁI NGUYÊN-MÊ LINH file). Names are compared against existing configs and only products NOT yet configured are shown for selection. Rows without a short name are still accepted — one is generated from the product name ("auto" badge).

uploadConfigDialog.autoShortTitle: Short name missing in file — the product name is used as the short name; edit later on the Products page if needed
